description: Source code for a Kivy-based video player implementation using GStreamer, including class definition for VideoGstplayer and related functions.

classes.name: VideoGstplayer
classes.description: A video player class implementing playback using GStreamer within the Kivy framework.

methods.name: _on_gst_eos_sync
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream synchronization by scheduling EOS callback.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the video using GStreamer, initializes the player and callback.

methods.name: unload
methods.description: Unloads the video player and clears buffers.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the video.

methods.name: _get_duration
methods.description: Retrieves total duration of the video.

methods.name: _set_volume
methods.description: Sets the volume of the player.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates the video frame buffer and texture.

methods.name: _update_texture
methods.description: Updates the texture with new video frame data.

methods.name: _get_uri
methods.description: Constructs the URI for the video file.
